headline: Executive order widens who can qualify for certain military medals and awards.
what_it_does: This order changes the rules for certain military decorations and awards so that more people can be eligible to receive them. The title does not say which awards are covered or exactly who is newly eligible. No summary was provided, so the details are unclear.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Some service members may now qualify for certain medals or awards they could not receive before.
